title: Class Imbalance
description: Train the muscle that production classifiers demand: when accuracy misleads, when SMOTE helps vs hurts, how to tune classification thresholds against business objectives, and which metric tells the truth on an imbalanced multi-class problem.
outcomes: You'll recognise where class imbalance silently invalidates accuracy, choose between SMOTE, class weights, and threshold tuning based on the production cost structure, and pick evaluation metrics that survive multi-class imbalance without misleading reporting.
